Audit whether existing complete large-prime graph relations remove the original FB30 ambiguity before collecting new geometric relations. This PR freezes the prospective sixty-call protocol and source-linked inspected report before any new implementation or population computation. [pcc:unverified]

Source **71ce8c85fd47b3144ce8e839a16bcfd51cc1426c**, protocol **8f7bac**, source-review correction **b10aea**, governance **04a56b**. The exact commit is normally published on research/chained-transfer-lp-presentation-20261115 and new tag **chained-transfer-lp-protocol-20261115-71ce8c85fd47**; base snapshot82617f14 retains the existing diagnostic CI source. [pcc:unverified]

Compare the frozen captured matrix, that matrix plus every unchanged uncapped rooted-cycle row, and the complete LP presentation projected onto the original FB/eta coordinates. Keep every full/ground/edge/vertex record, all60calls/15FB30failures/45larger-base controls, four complete A/P/C/U certificates per call (240total), every operation/basis/zero projection/lift/inclusion, whole negative and feedback controls, original360certificate replay and separate post-generation character audit. The producer receives only a public graph/matrix view, never BSGS/character/answer data. The quantity compared is projected image dimension, not nuisance-variable nullity. [pcc:unverified]

The exact source shows rooted traversal starts only at grounds and has a cap that rows_mult changes. Correctionb10aea preserves the old b76887 report and all numeric results while retracting its overly broad parameter-independence inference. Whether extra constraints exist in the fixed graphs is unmeasured. Diem2012/full source hashes and complete failed KB receipts are recorded; no novelty/absence/global-character/numerical-Lean/cost claim. [pcc:unverified]

The complete Markdown/Typst/SVG/47,962-byte PDF report is included; both pages actually opened. Full earlier queue/negative-history text is frozen verbatim, so the live [queue3904](https://github.com/isogeny-labs/crypto/issues/3904) can remain concise. A named full-presentation problem has exact exit criteria. [pcc:unverified]

Validation: original1605source guards, append-only ledger, live prose, working/staged whitespace, report-Python, workflow wiring and artifact-policy0; every new subject exact and staged or parented. Original scientific code/workflows/tools/policy unchanged. No algorithm or population trial yet. Next: generic Lean identities/native identity certificates and meaningful graph unit cases, then independent producer/replay. The full population uses EKS after known live budget/capacity/source image/checkpoint admission; USD2 per attempt/USD4 total, no paid job/build submitted. [pcc:unverified]

[Consumer1578](https://github.com/isogeny-labs/cryptanalysis/pull/1578) tracks fresh original diagnostic CI02 at826. [Root4347](https://github.com/isogeny-labs/crypto/pull/4347) retains a failed metadata publication race; a separately prospective original-tool/tag transport is being prepared. Existing shared-ledger merge conflicts remain unresolved. Feature-base auto-merge is unavailable; required checks/review/merge gates still apply. [pcc:unverified]
